'''Heedley''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]], he was seeking assistance with capturing an escaped fugitive named [[Vomba]].<ref name="Terminal" />
